entries.summary: When a generated test passes against a mocked DB, run an integration smoke pass before declaring success — mocked passes have historically masked migration breakage.
Catching every error and logging it can hide real failures. Re-throw or surface unrecognized errors instead of returning a silent fallback.
If a multi-step external action lacks rollback semantics, do not begin step N+1 until you have a recovery plan for the prior step's side effects.
